name: safari-ai-agent
description: Safari iPad Userscripts bridge and MCP browser automation gateway

scripts.build: node tools/build.mjs && node tools/build-remote.mjs && node extension/build.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/*.test.cjs tests/*.test.mjs extension/*.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run test && node --check scripts/safari-ai-agent.user.js && node --check scripts/safari-ai-agent-remote.user.js && node --check gateway/server.mjs && node --check gateway/diagnostics.mjs && node --check extension/web/background.js && node --check extension/web/content/content.js && node extension/build.mjs --check
scripts.test:browser: python3 tests/browser_e2e.py && python3 tests/remote_dom_smoke.py && python3 tests/remote_gateway_integration.py && python3 tests/remote_browser_e2e.py
